messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#758] Error in rawToChar(r) in rhbase
parts:
Hi,
I am not sure what you mean by "supported" here. I am inclined to say that this serialization option should not attempt any conversion, and this error is a result of that and the correct behavior would be to return a raw vector matching byte-by-byte the content of the hbase data retrieved. Is that what you expect also? If by "supported" you mean compressing and decompressing, no, I am pretty sure that's not a capability present at the moment. Thanks


Antonio
